name: Unitika Ltd.
summary: Unitika Ltd. engages in the polymer, functional material, and textile businesses in Japan, China, the rest of Asia, and internationally. The company offers nylon and polyester films; nylon, polyester, and arylate resins; glass fibers; reflective materials; woven and knitted fabrics; cotton products; and spun yarns. It also engages in the processing and sales of plastic and chemical products; sales of high molecular weight products; and dyeing, finishing, and processing of woven and knitted products.
